method: One bounded GET registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100 per token, curl -s -m 15, first page only, same convention as R6/R9. count = metadata.count (raw row count, includes one row per stored version). capped = metadata.nextCursor present. score = empty_slot_score x fit x buildability, empty_slot_score = 100/(1+count). fit/buildability are this round's qualitative 0-1 call against the 22-server suite (bank-statement, barcode, billing-docs, calendar, clauses, currency, deposits, docx, expense-tracker, image, invoice, kanban, office-suite, pdf, per-diem, price-tracker, quotes, recurring, resume, spreadsheet, time-tracker, timezone, zip; asset-register being built), pure-TypeScript no-network buildability gate.
cap: 30 wall minutes, curl -s -m 15 inline, at most 60 registry requests, no background jobs, no paid APIs

probes.covered_by_existing: expense-tracker (mileage already held, rank 1 in R6)
probes.note: redundant with existing mileage coverage on expense-tracker, folds in rather than standalone
fuel-cost calculator (user-entered price/mileage, no live price network call) fits as an expense-tracker variant

mostly x402/crypto 'toll' metaphor servers (tollbooth, tollmint), not toll-road expense tools; weak signal, folds into expense-tracker if built at all

probes.spec: Pure-TS cash-book / general ledger for freelancers and small businesses: dated debit/credit entries, running balance, category tags, monthly close and export; no network calls, pairs with expense-tracker and invoice.

Pure-TS petty-cash fund tracker: opening float, itemized disbursements with receipts references, reconciliation to a target float, replenishment log; no network calls, pairs with cash-book and expense-tracker.

probes.note: loan amortization calculator is pure math (no live-rate network call); pairs with per-diem/asset-register finance bundle

probes.spec: Pure-TS loan/asset amortization schedule generator: principal, rate, term in, full period-by-period schedule (principal/interest/balance) out via static formulas; no network calls, pairs with asset-register depreciation and per-diem finance bundle.

probes.exclusion_reason: entirely noise: page-1 hits are 'Pinterest' substring matches (pinterest-ads, pinterest-mcp), not finance-interest servers

probes.spec: Pure-TS dunning/collections letter sequence generator: staged reminder-to-formal-notice templates keyed off invoice due-date and overdue-days thresholds, reusing docx/invoice template engine; no network calls.
